qualification.reason: The document is an Expression of Interest (EOI) issued by the Ohio Department of Mental Health and Addiction Services for Recovery Month Events funding, including submission deadlines, funding amounts, and eligibility requirements.

quotes.quote: Recovery Month Events – Expression of Interest (EOI)
Request for Applications Due Date: 07/25/2025, by 3 p.m. EDT
OhioMHAS utilizes the EOI to conduct market research to identify organizations interested in participating in a proposed opportunity.

OhioMHAS is requesting expressions of interest from potential prevention, treatment, and/or recovery supports providers; community coalitions; recovery community organizations; peer run organizations; housing providers; faith-based organizations; schools; and other non-profit community organizations.
To qualify for the proposed opportunity, the organizations intending to participate must meet the following requirements:

findings.title: Reporting Requirement
findings.fact: Organizations are required to report to OhioMHAS how funds were utilized using the OhioMHAS outcomes survey. Completed surveys are due no later than November 7, 2025.

quotes.quote: Organizations are required to report to OhioMHAS how funds were utilized using the OhioMHAS outcomes survey. OhioMHAS will provide the survey link and the SOS questionnaire (if applicable) for required reporting. Completed surveys are due no later than November 7, 2025.

findings.title: Eligible Organization Types
findings.fact: Eligible organizations include prevention, treatment, and/or recovery supports providers; community coalitions; recovery community organizations; peer run organizations; housing providers; faith-based organizations; schools; and other non-profit community organizations.
findings.business_implication: This opportunity is open to a wide range of community-based organizations, not just traditional treatment providers. This broadens the potential applicant pool, but also means competition may be high.
findings.action_recommendation: Confirm that your organization falls into one of the listed categories. If so, proceed with preparing the EOI. If not, consider partnering with an eligible organization.

quotes.quote: OhioMHAS is requesting expressions of interest from potential prevention, treatment, and/or recovery supports providers; community coalitions; recovery community organizations; peer run organizations; housing providers; faith-based organizations; schools; and other non-profit community organizations.

findings.title: Federal Tax Identification Number Required
findings.fact: Organizations must have a federal tax identification number (FTID).
findings.business_implication: Having a valid FTID is a basic prerequisite for applying. Without it, the organization cannot be considered for funding.
findings.action_recommendation: Verify that your organization has a valid FTID. If not, obtain one before the EOI deadline.

quotes.quote: Organizations must have a federal tax identification number (FTID).

findings.title: 501(c)(3) Non-Profit Status Required
findings.business_implication: Only organizations with 501(c)(3) status are eligible. This excludes for-profit entities and some other non-profit types. This may limit the applicant pool.
findings.action_recommendation: Ensure your organization has current 501(c)(3) status. If not, consider partnering with a qualifying non-profit or applying through a fiscal sponsor.

findings.title: Funding Expended by September 29, 2025
findings.fact: All awards must be fully expended by September 29, 2025.
findings.business_implication: The funding period is very short (about 2 months). Organizations must be able to plan and execute activities within this tight timeframe. Failure to expend funds by the deadline could result in loss of funding or other penalties.
findings.action_recommendation: Assess your organization's capacity to implement activities and spend funds by the deadline. Develop a detailed project plan with clear milestones to ensure timely expenditure.

quotes.quote: All awards must be fully expended by September 29, 2025.

findings.title: EOI Submission Deadline
findings.fact: The EOI must be submitted by July 25, 2025 at 3:00 p.m. EDT via the Microsoft form.
findings.business_implication: The deadline is critical. Missing it will disqualify the application. The submission is via an online form, so technical issues could arise.
findings.action_recommendation: Submit the EOI well before the deadline to avoid last-minute issues. Prepare all required information in advance and test the form early. Mark the deadline on calendars and set reminders.

quotes.quote: Request for Applications Due Date: 07/25/2025, by 3 p.m. EDT
To submit your expression of interest please complete all questions on the Microsoft form at https://forms.office.com/g/2YnKfqHta7 by July 25th at 3:00 p.m.

findings.title: Funding Restrictions
findings.fact: Funding is for one-time events only and cannot support ongoing services, salaries, or unallowable expenses such as food and entertainment.
findings.business_implication: The grant cannot be used for recurring operational costs or non-essential items, which may limit the scope of the event and require careful budget planning to ensure all expenses are eligible.
findings.action_recommendation: Review the full list of allowable and unallowable expenses, and design the event budget to strictly comply with the restrictions, avoiding any food or entertainment costs.

quotes.quote: The event (s) awarded under this funding opportunity will be viewed as one-time only and should not support ongoing services/supports/salaries.
Entertainment expenses (e.g., musicians, dunk tanks, giveaways, etc.)
